artboards.title: AI Visual Components — Core motif, 6 motion states, AI cards, Voice, Chat bubbles

annotations.text: Prompt 49 — AI visual components per UI-UX §199. AI Core layered-rings motif with 6 motion states: Idle/Listening/Processing/Speaking/Error/Offline. All AI components use --color-ai (#4A3D6B) and --color-ai-surface (#F0EDF8). AI diamond mark is the consistent brand motif.
